newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador Q1 GDP grew 0.3 pct -- Central Bank.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador Q1 GDP grew 0.3 pct -- Central Bank.

text.p: Ecuador's gross domestic product grew 0.3 percent in the first quarter of this year, slowing from 0.6 percent in the same period of 1996, a senior Central Bank source said Thursday.
The source, who requested anonymity, said that political uncertainty was partly responsible for the slower growth.
Abdala Bucaram was elected president in July last year, but Congress removed him in February and elected Fabian Alarcon as interim president until August 1998.
The government predicts annual growth this year of 3.3 percent, up from 2.3 percent last year, but down from 4.3 percent in 1994.
Growth between January and March was led by financial services, which rose 5.6 percent, followed by 2.1 percent growth in electricity and 1.8 percent in agriculture.
The transport sector contracted 5.1 percent, while construction was off 4.7 percent, followed by a 1.6 percent fall in government services and 0.3 percent in manufacturing, the source said.
In the last quarter of 1996, Ecuador's GDP grew 1.4 percent.
